title: Buddha Dhatu Jadi
visualBrief: Buddha Dhatu Jadi standing hilltop shrine: round yellow/gilded enclosed hall with maroon/gold columned outer arcade, true recessed closed portal, lobed original arcade heads/entry crest, round gray roof/maroon-gold parapet. Broad central bell/ringed conical neck/crown/open umbrella finial and eight smaller surrounding stupas. Pictured teardrop paved terrace/blue-pale boundary posts, dark gold-edged pointed-end tiered canopy, simplified original seated figures/lotus seats/small umbrellas. Upper approach/gold gateway and mapped stair descent to the retained third stair control. Exact rooms, fine copied sculpture/inscriptions, forest/solar fixtures/visitor objects and remaining lower path are not authored.
